note: Every native read of bAllowFriendlyFire / bAllowAlliedViz found by re-grepping the checkout this session, with the port disposition. 'implemented' = the port reads the same mission param at the same decision point; 'structural' = the native code path has no port counterpart; 'client-side' = a native client-local rendering/UI check that the server-authoritative port replaces with exports/params.

friendly_fire.rule: ship-ship collision damage passes the other ship as launcher, so the ReceiveDamage gate covers ramming
CprobeIGC::ReceiveDamage: FF off + friendly launcher + !c_eabmRescueAny + armed probe => c_drNoDamage; sensor and RescueAny probes stay damageable
friendly_fire.before: no gate at all (P100/P491 contract: every probe took friendly fire); P649 tests asserted the non-native behaviour

friendly_fire.rule: IsideIGC::AlliedSides used by every FF/viz gate
friendly_fire.before: only the host/test AlliedSidePairs set; production never filled it, so the allied leg of every gate was dead

friendly_fire.rule: DockWithStationEvent captures an ALLIED station only when bAllowFriendlyFire
friendly_fire.port: src/Allegiance.Server/ServerHost.cs DockWithStationEvent - friendly-only docking; the hostile/ally-capture-on-dock branch is documented out of scope (P760)

friendly_fire.rule: Create-game checkbox, Game Details summary line and MISSIONPARAMS write
friendly_fire.port: games[].allowFriendlyFire / ALLEGIANCE_GAME_ALLOW_FRIENDLY_FIRE / --friendly-fire; skirmish row; GAME DETAILS panel FF FIRE line; MISSIONDEF bit 28

allied_visualization.rule: an armed probe's first shot reveals it to sides with scanners, and to allied sides without one when bAllowAlliedViz
allied_visualization.note: gate exists; its IsFriendlySide now resolves live alliance groups through Mission.AreSidesFriendly

allied_visualization.rule: UpdateSideVisibility: an allied side sees the model with no scanner when bAllowAlliedViz
allied_visualization.before: dropped unconditionally (pre-existing 'no alliance concept' simplification, now obsolete)

allied_visualization.rule: a contact spotted by one ally's scanner is shown to its other allies with that same last spotter
RevealAlliedClusters at map creation: every model of a cluster where a side owns a station is revealed to its allies (never warps)
allied_visualization.port: src/Allegiance.Core/Model/Mission.cs RevealAlliedClusters, called from SeedStartingVisibility in native order

allied_visualization.rule: SetCluster: with allied viz a model that changes sector is only hidden from non-allied sides
allied_visualization.port: none - a model that leaves the sector simply stops being a sweep target, so there is no hide-on-sector-change state to relax

allied_visualization.rule: ShowObject/HideObject stop spamming ship status to allies and never hide allied ships
allied_visualization.port: the host export sweeps read the SeenBySide flags this sweep writes, so the allied legs above produce the same export set

allied_visualization.rule: FindRipcordModel (allied-rip branch): an allied station/ship anchor counts when SeenBySide or bAllowAlliedViz
allied_visualization.port: src/Allegiance.Server/Server.cs FindRipcordModel uses bAllowAlliedRip + AlliedSides without a visibility test
allied_visualization.note: bAllowAlliedRip (P115) anchor search is scoped to the requested sector and visibility-agnostic; wiring allied viz could only tighten it, which is left to the allied-rip owner

allied_visualization.rule: client-side rendering/roster/map checks plus the client forcing its LOCAL MissionParams copy on when allies exist
allied_visualization.port: server-authoritative: visibility comes from EXPORTs driven by the sweep above, so the client has no local copy to force; the setting reaches the client in MISSIONDEF bit 6
